_comment: Captured from GitHub's GraphQL API with aigate's review_threads query, on a
real pull request with real Cursor Bugbot findings. The human author's login,
the thread ids and the file paths are replaced with placeholders.
It pins GitHub's actual response shape: in the same payload the reviewer's
login is 'cursor' (no [bot] suffix) under comments[].author.login but
'cursor[bot]' under resolvedBy.login. The parser must treat both as the
gh api graphql -f owner=<owner> -f name=<repo> -F pr=<n> -f query='...'
